name.description: Target name (admin, web, mobile, ...): script api:generate:<name> and the openapitools.json generator key

doc.description: OpenAPI document to generate from (openapi/<doc>.json): admin or client. Default: admin for --name admin, otherwise client

target.description: Output folder of the generated client, relative to the project (e.g. ../shop-admin/src/app/core/api)

pubName.description: dart-dio only: Dart package name. Default: <project>_<name>_api

force.description: Replace an existing target with the same name
